name: Bade Achhe Lagte Hain
description: Bade Achhe Lagte Hain  is the sublime love story of an unexpected relationship. A marriage of compromise between two completely opposite personalities blossoms into a true partnership.

videos.title: Ram Is Lonely
videos.overview: A female pageant is organized in the city of dreams, Mumbai. Priya Sharma reaches on the registration desk to register her sister's name, Aisha. Priya Sharma is a lecturer. Business tycoon, Ram Kapoor, rushes for her sister Ipshikha's marriage. Priya explains the importance of love and marriage to her students.Ram gets extremely hurt as his mother didn't tell Ram to perform a small ritual in the marriage function. He feels lonely. Will Priya and Ram meet ? Will they fall in love? What has destiny planned for them?

videos.title: Aisha's Birthday Party
videos.overview: Priya reaches her residence to wish her sister, Aisha, but her mother had already organized a party without informing her. Vikram explains to Ram that he did so much for his family but his family doesn't value him. Priya's father urges her to find a life partner who can love her, support her, and think for her. Ram's mother discloses to Ipshikha that she never wanted Ram to get married. Vikram plans to make Ram meet a girl for marriage. Will Ram agree for marriage?

videos.title: Marriage Proposals
videos.overview: Priya's father again expresses his concern for her marriage. Priya's father urges her friend, Shruti, to talk to Priya about her marriage. Shruti introduces Priya to Vishal for her Marriage. Rehaan introduces a well-known model to Ram in regards to his marriage. Neha fights with Rehaan. Coincidently Ram and Priya are in the same restaurant. Will they meet? What has destiny planned for them?

videos.title: Ram Meets With A Small Accident
videos.overview: Ram Kapoor explains Vikram that he does not want to marry as he has crossed 40 and girls will marry him only because he is a rich tycoon. Priya too explains to her father that there is someone who is waiting for her. Priya discloses the unknown person's voice. Priya's mother releases her frustration on Priya. Priya's mother dashes her car with Ram's car. Will Ram and Priya meet this time? Will she recognize Ram's voice?

videos.title: The First Meeting
videos.overview: Priya's mother creates a scene as Ram's car accidentally dashes with Priya's car. Vikram apologizes for his mistake and urges Priya's mother to wind up the situation quickly. Ram misses his father's worship. Ram warns Priya's mother that he will destroy her. Priya and her father visit the police station instead of her mother.

videos.title: Karthik Slaps Natasha
videos.overview: Priya reaches Ram Kapoor's residence and Aisha Sharma reaches Ram's sister, Natasha Kapoor's studio, as she was selected for her fashion show. Natasha keeps her waiting for hours. A guest insults Natasha and Ram fumes in anger. Aisha's brother Karthik slaps Natasha Kapoor. Natasha likes Karthik. Karthik slaps Natasha as she made his sister wait for hours. She fumes in anger and accidentally her wrist gets cut by glass. Ram gets tensed. What will Ram do now?

videos.title: A Concerned Brother
videos.overview: Ram fumes in anger and urges Vikram to collect information about Karthik. Priya's mother Shipra can't believe that Natasha Kapoor likes Karthik. Priya's mother fumes in anger as she discloses to the police the incident that happened. Ram's mother forces Ram for Natasha and Karthik's marriage. Ram strictly denies. Priya calls Ram and discloses that there is no need to take this accident seriously. A huge misunderstanding is created between Ram and Priya, but who will clear it? Will Ram agree for Natasha and Karthik's marriage?

videos.title: Ram Decides To Meet Karthik's Family
videos.overview: Ram's mother orders Ram to talk to Karthik's parents as she wants Natasha to get married with Karthik, as she loves her. Ram fumes in anger. Priya gets upset, as her mother again shows her a photo of a guy who is much elder to her. Ram explains to Natasha to forget Karthik but she strictly denies it. Ram decides to meet Karthik's family. Will Ram and Priya meet this time?

videos.title: Shipra Plans To Call The Press
videos.overview: Ram and Priya converse for the first time. Priya identifies Ram's driver as he brings tablets for Ram. Ram and Priya both fumes in anger and fight with each other. The misunderstanding is still not cleared. Ram is talking about her sister Natasha and Priya is talking about his car. Shipra plans to call the press. Ram discloses Natasha that he has finalized her and Karthik's marriage. Karthik reveals that Ram Kapoor had visited Sharma residence to talk about Natasha's marriage. Shipra behaves crazy. Will Vikram clear his misunderstanding? Will Ram meet Priya again?

videos.title: Ram and Priya Decide To Meet
videos.overview: Karthik discloses about Natasha to Priya that he likes her. Priya calls Ram to talk about Natasha and Karthik's marriage but they again fight with each other, and she also calls Ram fat. Karthik finally accepts Natasha. Ram and Priya decide to meet. Vikram gives instructions to Ram and Shipra gives instructions to Priya as it's their first meeting. Will they again fight or talk politely with each other? What will be Priya's decision for Karthik's marriage?

videos.title: Priya Apologies To Ram
videos.overview: Priya apologizes Ram, as she insulted him by calling fat during their previous phone conversations. Priya invites Ram with his family members at her residence in regard to Natasha and Karthik's marriage. What will happen when Ram's family will meet Priya's mother, Shipra, who is extremely excited about Natasha and Karthik's marriage?

videos.title: Priya Is Angry At Karthik
videos.overview: Karthik denies to marry Natasha and discloses that until and unless his elder sister Priya does not marry he won't marry Natasha. Ram Kapoor appreciates Karthik's love for his family and his sister. He promises that Natasha will marry Karthik. Priya gets angry at Karthik. Natasha decides to go to London.

videos.title: Hunt For An Eligible Bachelor
videos.overview: Shipra calls a priest to find out a good looking boy for Priya. Priya gets angry as Aisha mentions her age wrong. Vikram and Ram discuss Priya. Aisha and Priya discuss Natasha's behaviour. Vikram urges Ram to ask Priya with regards to the selection of a boy. Ram meets Priya at her coaching classes to ask her which kind of boy she would like to marry? Will Priya select a boy for herself? What will be Priya's decision?

videos.title: Priya Gets A Proposal
videos.overview: Shipra gets angry with Ashwin. Ipshikha's mother-in-law brings a marriage proposal for Ram but Ram's mother avoids it. Ram's mother discloses her worry to her brother, Raghav, in regards to Ram's marriage. Ram gets tensed as he has to find a boy for Priya in 1 week. Priya's mother Shipra discloses that a boy has selected Priya in regards to the marriage and wants to meet her. Will Priya meet him?

videos.title: Will Priya Marry Vinit?
videos.overview: Natasha threatens Karthik to come along with her for a movie. Priya meets Vinit in regards to her marriage. Priya urges Vinit to give her some time for her final decision. All family members are quiet positive for Priya and Vinit's marriage. Will Priya agree to marry Vinit? What will be Priya's final decision?

videos.title: Priya's Engagement
videos.overview: Ram discloses his secret of life, that he lives for his family. Priya finds Ram's voice familiar. Niharika watches Natasha fighting with Karthik, thus, she instantly decides to fix their engagement function. Ram discloses to Vikram that there is no perfect match for Priya. Natasha warns Karthik that she will leave him and go back to her ex-boyfriend. Is Priya really happy with her engagement? What has destiny planned for Ram and Priya?

videos.title: Priya Is Heartbroken
videos.overview: Priya's father, Sudhir, gets extremely angry at Shipra as she was differentiating between Karthik and Priya. Ram discloses to Natasha that she has selected the best boy for herself. All family members are extremely happy and excited for Priya's engagement. Ram urges Priya not to get engaged. Vikram shares some important information with Ram in regards to the boy who is getting engaged with Priya. Priya's father blames Ram. Will Priya forgive Ram?

videos.title: Another Marriage Prospect For Priya
videos.overview: Priya promises Sharma and Kapoor family that Karthik and Natasha will definitely get married. Priya gets extremely upset. Raghav discloses to his sister Niharika about Ram and Priya's marriage. Niharika considers Priya as her biggest obstacle. Ram feels guilty about the incident. Raghav reveals to Niharika that Ram and Priya's marriage will be super beneficial. Will Ram agree to marry Priya? What will be Priya and her family's decision?

videos.title: Another Confusion
videos.overview: Ram Kapoor gets a shock as Niharika discloses to Ram about Priya for his marriage. Ram couldn't believe that his mother selected Priya for his marriage. On the other hand, a big confusion happens in Priya's house as all members are assuming that Ram's marriage proposal is for Aisha. Sharma family reaches Kapoors' residence with Aisha.

videos.title: Priya Rejects The Proposal
videos.overview: Niharika takes the initiative to clear the misunderstanding that happened between Sharma and Kapoor family. Sharma family gets shocked to hear that Ram's marriage was fixed with Priya and not with Aisha. Priya's intentions were not to insult the Kapoor family. Raghav urges Niharika to persuade Ram for marriage at any cost. Will Priya and Ram agree to marry each other? What will be Ram's decision?

videos.title: Ram And Priya Decide To Meet
videos.overview: The Sharma family completely agrees with Priya and Ram's marriage proposal but Priya does not take it seriously. Finally, Ayesha persuades Priya to meet Ram and Priya agrees too. Priya and Ram both prepare to meet each other. Ram and Priya both loose their cool and fight with each other. Natasha becomes a trouble for Karthik. The media people take snaps of Ram and Priya in the restaurant as they assume them as a future couple. What will Rama and Priya do now?

videos.title: Ram And Priya Make The Headlines
videos.overview: The media and news channel suddenly takes snaps and interviews of Ram and Priya during their conversation in the restaurant and spreads the news that Ram purposed Priya. Shipra again insults Priya. Priya gets shock to see her photograph in the newspaper. Ram gets upset. Priya's family and Ram's family are extremely happy with the news that has been aired on the T.V. Will Ram and Priya agree for marriage? What will be Ram and Priya's decision?

videos.title: A Compromise
videos.overview: Priya and Ram both disclose their engagement date and time to their respective families. Family members gets surprised to hear the time as Ram and Priya wants to get engaged in the night at 10.30 pm. Priya and Ram both select ring for each other. Vikram and Neha helps Ram to get ready for his engagement. All family members of Kapoor and Sharma are extremely happy in regards to Ram and Priya's engagement ceremony. Will Ram and Priya ever fall in love?

videos.title: Ram And Priya's Engagement
videos.overview: Kapoor family and Sharma family clicks photographs with Ram and Priya in regards to their engagement ceremony. Natasha forces Karthik to come along with her in the party but Karthik strictly denies. Neha and Vikram shows Ram's room to Priya. Natasha visits her friends party against Karthik's order. Ram and Priya discloses their likes and dislikes. Ram disagrees to share his cupboard space with Priya. Will they ever fall in love?

videos.title: Natasha Insults Priya
videos.overview: Vikram gets tensed as he gets a job opportunity from a multinational firm, but he will have to leave Ram Kapoor's firm which will affect his friendship. Natasha's friend informs Karthik about the fake accident of Natasha. She insults Priya and Karthik fumes in anger. Will Natasha break her engagement with Karthik? Will it affect Priya and Ram's marriage?

videos.title: Natasha And Karthik Break Up
videos.overview: Natasha gets bruises on her face as Karthik slapped her. Natasha discloses to Ram that she does not want to marry Karthik. Ram fumes in anger and heads towards Karthik's residence. Sudhir slaps Karthik. Karthik reveals the truth. What will be Ram and Priya's final decision in regards to their marriage? Will Natasha forgive Karthik?

videos.title: Karthik Apologizes To Natasha
videos.overview: Ram Kapoor informs her mother that he wants to break his engagement with Priya as Karthik and Natasha's engagement is broken. Shipra fumes in anger as society people insults Priya. Karthik puts the whole blame on himself. Natasha makes Karthik sit on his knees to accept his apology. Priya considers her engagement with Ram as an accident. Shipra's car again meets with an accident. Will Karthik's apology make a difference? Will Priya and Ram get married?

videos.title: Natasha Is Expecting
videos.overview: Natasha's heath gets disturbed in regards to frequent vomiting. Niharika doubts on Natasha and forces her to go through a test. Niharika fumes in anger as Natasha is expecting a child. Priya discloses Ram about breaking their relationship and also urges to exchange the ring. Niharika reveals a shocking truth to Natasha about Ram and forces her to marry Karthik. Will Natasha agree to marry Karthik? What will be Ram's decision?

videos.title: Ram Is In A Dilemma
videos.overview: Ram is frustrated with the whole situation as Natasha suddenly decides to marry Karthik without any terms and conditions. Ram finally agrees that he is engaged to Priya. Ashwin promises Priya that he will keep her happy. Priya declares Ram as his fiance in front of Ashwin. Will destiny bring Ram and Priya together? Will they agree for marriage?

videos.title: Priya Shows Ram Her Secret Room
videos.overview: Natasha decides to reveal the truth to Karthik about her child but Niharika stops her. Shipra discloses Priya that Niharika has confirmed Ram's marriage with Priya. Niharika orders priest to fix Ram and Priya's marriage date as fast as possible. A clash happens between the two priests in regards to marriage dates. Priya shows her secret room to Ram which has played a very significant role in her life. Which date will be fixed for Ram and Priya's marriage?

videos.title: Wedding Bells
videos.overview: Ram and Priya share their marriage happiness with all the family members. Ram gets extremely excited about his marriage preparations and urges Vikram to call Siddhanth. Ram discusses his marriage preparations with both the family members. Priya explicates Ram that her father Sudhir has lots of expectations in regards to her marriage which Sudhir is unable to perform. What will be Ram's decision?

videos.title: Ram Wins Sudhir's Heart
videos.overview: Ram Kapoor assures Priya's father Sudhir that he has all rights to organize his daughter's marriage in whichever way he wants and will support him. Ram discloses his family members that both the marriages will be conducted at different places. Is there a trouble waiting for Sharma family? What will be Niharika and her brother's planning?

videos.title: Ram Becomes A Laughing Stock
videos.overview: Ram calls Priya and urges her to book an AC hall, as he has, a breathing problem. Priya and her family members fail to control their laughter. Niharika forces Ram to go on a date with Priya as they are soon going to get married. Ram gets tensed. Niharika gets a call from Apeksha Malhotra. Is she related to Ram Kapoor and his family?

videos.title: Double Date
videos.overview: Ram picks Priya from her coaching classes. Natasha and Karthik are extremely excited as this is their first date and gets engaged in romance. Ram and Priya's conversations are pretty formal. Ram watches Cricket match whereas Priya reads the book. Apeksha's call disturbs Ram. Niharika gets tensed as her mother-in-law arrives. Will Ram and Priya enjoy their first date?

videos.title: Ram And Priya Spend Some Quality Time
videos.overview: Sudhir teases Shipra as his mother-in-law is arriving. Shipra guides Karthik to leave Ram and Priya alone in the car. Shipra and her mother get extremely excited as they watch Ram and Priya together. Priya describes Ram to her Naani and Ram describes Priya to his Daadi. Will Apeksha Malhotra be a hurdle in Ram and Priya's marriage? What will Ram do now?

videos.title: Clashing Views
videos.overview: Shipra and Sudhir receives their guest and relatives. Shipra breaks down in to tears as her mother informs her about a function in which there will be a small question answer session for Ram in regards to Priya's marriage at Ram's residence. Kapoor family strictly denies to perform the function. Shipra's mother fumes in anger. Will Ram succeed in convincing his Daadi?

videos.title: The Shobha Ceremony
videos.overview: Daadi gets emotional as Ram refreshes his Daadaji's memories and reveals how he respected every ceremony regards to the marriage. Ram notifies Priya about Sobha ceremony and Sharma family expresses their happiness. Niharika's brother informs her about the arrival of Apeksha Malhotra. Niharika gets tensed. Sharma family visits Ram's residence for Shobha ceremony.

videos.title: Family Get Together
videos.overview: Ram Kapoor introduces Sharma family to his relatives and Daadi. The Sobha Ceremony begins where Naani starts questioning Ram which becomes difficult for him to answer, but also assures Naani that he will keep Priya happy. Priya discloses few personal details about herself to Daadi. Apeksha Malhotra visits Ram Kapoor's residence. Will Ram meet Apeksha? Will Priya come to know about Ram's past?

videos.title: Ram Is Furious
videos.overview: Daadi and Naani try to affront each other with regards to the selection of costumes and jewellery. Priya smartly handles the situation by giving individual choices to Daadi and Naani. Apeksha Malhotra forces Ram to meet her and he fumes in anger. Ram thanks Priya for handling the situation. The marriage preparations in full swing. Will Ram reveal Priya about Apeksha?

videos.title: Wedding Shopping
videos.overview: Priya, Shruti and Ayesha decide to go for shopping. Ram tries his marriage outfit and finds it too fit. Vikram and Neha decide to organize strict dieting for Ram. Priya's friend Shruti conducts a small party. Priya tries several outfits and gets confused. Ram doubts that Apeksha Malhotra might spoil his marriage. Sudhir and Priya gets emotional. Will Niharika and her brother save Ram from Apeksha Malhotra?

videos.title: Ram Faints Due To Stress
videos.overview: Ram finds it difficult to control his diet. Niharika plans to organize marriage related functions in a hall inspite of the house. Niharika discloses her plan of organizing Sangeet and Mehndi ceremony of Ram, Priya, Karthik and Natasha on the same day and Sudhir agrees. Shipra worries about Priya. Apeksha Malhotra visits Ram Kapoor's office. Ram faints due to over stress. Employee informs Niharika that Ram is admitted in the hospital. Will Ram reveal Priya about Apeksha?

videos.title: Cops Arrest Apeksha Malhotra
videos.overview: The Doctor discloses Niharika to postpone all the functions as it will affect Ram's health. Ram urges Niharika not to reveal Priya or her family members about his illness as it might disturb their function. The cops arrest Apeksha Malhotra. All family members are extremely happy in regards with Priya's mehendi and sangeet ceremony. Members resides for sangeet function. What will happen when Priya will come to know that Ram is hospitalized? Will Apeksha become a hurdle in Ram and Priya's marriage?

videos.title: Mehendi Ceremony
videos.overview: Kapoor and Sharma families are extremely busy in enjoying Sangeet and Mehndi. Priya calls Ram as he was missing from the function. Ram reveals to Priya that he is busy in a meeting and henceforth not to give a call. Vikram finally discloses the truth to Priya that due to low blood pressure, he is hospitalized. Priya gets a shock. What will Priya do now? Will Priya meet Ram?

videos.title: Thoughtful Priya
videos.overview: Priya discloses Ram that she left the Sangeet and Mehndi function when she came to know about his illness. Funny conversations take place between Ram and Priya. Nani fights with Daadi. Ram reveals his illness in front of all the family members. Daadi showers her blessings on Ram and Priya. What will be Apeksha Malhotra's next step?

videos.title: Rishabh Kapoor Surprises The Family
videos.overview: Ram's yonger brother, Rishabh Kapoor gives a huge surprise to Kapoor family. All members dance to the amazing tunes of Bollywood and gives a rocking dance performance. Students from blind school dedicates a devotional performance to Priya and Ram, supports her by donating a huge amount for their school. Is there a trouble waiting for Ram and Priya?

videos.title: Priya Is Emotional
videos.overview: Priya gets extremely emotional in regards with her family as she is soon going to be Mrs. Kapoor. Aisha expresses her feelings for Priya and also reveals how whole family is habitual to her. Journalist exposes the food menu which will be held during Natasha's marriage. Ram gets emotional in regards with her sister, Natasha. What kind of preparations has Priya done for Karthik's marriage?

videos.title: Karthik And Natasha Are Hitched
videos.overview: The groom Karthik Sharma and his family resides form his house and proceeds towards Ram Kapoor's residence for his marriage. News reporters attack Sharma family with their never-ending questions. Ram Kapoor and his family welcomes their guest and Sharma family in a unique way. Karthik finally ties the knot with Natasha. Ram gets emotional. Apeksha's lawyer informs her that after a hour she will be released from police station. What will Apeksha do now?

videos.title: Natasha's Stubbornness
videos.overview: Ram gets emotional as his dear sister, Natasha gets married to Karthik. Niharika doesn't call his son, Ram for Natasha's Kanyadaan, instead she searches for her son, Siddharth. Ram gets upset. Priya feels Ram's pain and assures him that her sister will be happy in Karthik's house. Karthik fumes in anger as Natasha forces him to go for honeymoon directly from the wedding venue. What will be Karthik's decision? Will he agree or disagree?

videos.title: Priya's Farewell
videos.overview: Shipra and Priya get emotional. Sudhir and Shipra's relatives fumes in anger as Karthik and Natasha directly reside for honeymoon from the marriage venue. Niharika finds the hall's location extremely odd. Ram urges their family members to respect Sharma family's emotions in regards with Priya's marriage. Sharma family breaks down into tears as Priya is leaving their house. Is there a trouble waiting for Ram and Priya?

videos.title: Priya Becomes A Bride
videos.overview: Shipra strictly warns Ashwin not to attend Priya and Ram's marriage. Ayesha gets a call for a modelling assignment but she strictly denies as she cannot miss Priya's wedding. Siddhanth lands in big trouble. Vikram forces Ram to sit on the horse. Priya and her family gets upset as her car creates a problem in the middle of the road. Priya seraches for Auto rickshaw but she fails to grab it. Will Priya and her family reach on time at the marriage venue?

videos.title: Broken Hearts
videos.overview: Ram, a successful businessman with a broken heart. Priya, a middle-class teacher who believes that love is nothing but a marketing gimmick. Will these two broken souls find their safe space in each other?

videos.title: Too Late For Love
videos.overview: Ram gets late for the engagement, and the procession begins without him. Meanwhile, Priya's sisters convince her to go on a blind date after she loses a bet.

videos.title: The Blind Date
videos.overview: Ram and Priya's dates don't go as planned. Ram ends up comforting Priya when she is at her lowest.

videos.title: Akshay And Shivina's Secret
videos.overview: Priya scolds Akshay and Shivina for keeping their relationship a secret. Ram wonders if he is doing the right thing by getting Shivina married.

videos.title: Shivina's Sangeet
videos.overview: Ram and Priya come face to face under grim circumstances. Ram thinks that Priya has kidnapped his sister, while Priya thinks that Ram is forcing his sister to get married.

videos.title: Didi Comes First
videos.overview: Akshay tells Ram that he can't think about his marriage till his sister finds a groom for herself. Ram and Priya face each other at court, defending their friends.

videos.title: Ram Sets Up Priya
videos.overview: Ram calls Priya to meet him and his friends, intending to set her up with Kunal. Nandini finds out Shivina's secret.

videos.title: Ram And Priya Fight
videos.overview: Ram's mother finds a solution for Ram and Shivina's problems. Priya gets angry when she finds out Rams real intentions for meeting her.

videos.title: Priya Confronts Ram
videos.overview: Priya finds out that Ram's mother brought her son's marriage proposal. Priya confronts Ram and asks him the reasons for his actions.

videos.title: Ram Agrees For Marriage
videos.overview: Priya chases Ram all day to find an opportunity and apologise to him. Ram finds out Shivina's secret and rushes to his family to make his decision heard loud and clear.

videos.title: Ram And Priya Meet
videos.overview: Ram and Priya agree to meet each other for the sake of their families. They begin to realise that they have more similarities than they thought.

videos.title: Priya Agrees For Marriage
videos.overview: Priya and Ram agree to get married for the happiness of their family. Both families are thrilled and start the preparations for the Roka.

videos.title: Priya's Past
videos.overview: Ram and Priyas Roka gets disrupted when the truth about Priyas past comes to light. Ram tries to save the day when Priyas family is left feeling embarrassed.

videos.title: Jackpot
videos.overview: Ram and Priya's engagement gets underway. Later, Priya is in for a shock when Mahendra turns up at their door.

videos.title: Sood Family History
videos.overview: Mahendra acts nice infront of everyone but secretly wants to ruin Ram and Priya's marriage. Meanwhile, Nandini questions the Sood family about their troubled past.

videos.title: Shaadi Ka Contract
videos.overview: Nandini is having second thoughts about Ram and Priya's marriage. She decides to send Shubham to Priya's house with prenup papers. Will Priya sign on those papers or choose to cancel the wedding?

videos.title: Maa Ka Aashirwad
videos.overview: Priya and her family refuse to sign the contract. Mahendra feels confident about the marriage getting called off. Meanwhile, Priya calls up Ram to talk to him about the contract.

videos.title: Loan Agreement
videos.overview: Upon Shivina's request, Ram decides to help Priya and make her smile. However, this task proves to be more challenging than it first appeared.

videos.title: Preparations For The Sangeet
videos.overview: The two families are preparing for the sangeet ceremony. However, Ram is missing, and no one has any clue about his whereabouts.

videos.title: Past Mistakes
videos.overview: During the Sangeet function, Neeraj antagonizes Priya by bringing up their past and creates yet another scene. How will Priya handle the situation?

videos.title: Sangeet Surprise
videos.overview: Ram overhears Neeraj disrespecting Priya during the Sangeet and decides to teach him a lesson. He plans a surprise in hopes of finally bringing a smile to Priya's face.

videos.title: Maa Ki Khwaish
videos.overview: Sid arrives at the Sangeet function to take his revenge on Priya. Meanwhile, Meera tells Nandini about their decision to host the marriage at a community hall.

videos.title: Bonding Over Cupcakes
videos.overview: While driving Sid back to his home, Shubham almost runs over Sandy. Priya decides to file a complaint against the driver at the police station.

videos.title: Shaadi Ka Invitation
videos.overview: The day of Ram and Priya's wedding is here. Despite Priya's issues with her father, Ram still decides to invite him to the wedding. Will Mahendra's presence cause more trouble for Ram and Priya?

videos.title: Ram Saves The Day
videos.overview: Priya reaches the community hall, only to realize that her wedding venue hasn't been vacated yet. Thankfully, Ram comes to her rescue.

videos.title: Allergic Reaction
videos.overview: Nandini decides to use Priya's video as an excuse to call off the wedding. Meanwhile, Rakhee finds out about Ram's allergies and tries to exploit them.

videos.title: Shaadi Mubarak
videos.overview: Ram and Priya's marriage is underway. However, the police arrive at the venue to enquire about the complaint Priya made against Shubham.

videos.title: Priya's Complaint
videos.overview: Priya's complaint against Shubham causes problems at the wedding. Ram feels humiliated and walks out from there. Is Ram and Priya's marriage in trouble?

videos.title: Search For Ram
videos.overview: Ram goes missing from the wedding venue, and Priya goes out to look for him. Will she find him before it is too late?

videos.title: Made For Each Other
videos.overview: Ram and Priya keep their differences aside and get married to each other for the sake of their families. What challenges await this newly married couple in the future?

videos.title: Burai Ka Dahan
videos.overview: The newlywed couple arrives at Priya's house for Vijaydashmi Pooja. Meanwhile, Mahendra meets with Shashi to confirm his suspicions.

videos.title: Damage Control
videos.overview: Ram's car breaks down, and he decides to spend the night at Priya's house. Is this an opportunity for the newlywed couple to get to know each other?

videos.title: Dulha Is Missing
videos.overview: Akshay and Shivina's wedding day is finally here. However, The Sood family is panicking as Akshay is nowhere to be found.

videos.title: Wedding Jitters
videos.overview: Shivina is getting worried as Akshay is not picking up her calls. Meanwhile, Priya arrives at the film studio to look for Akshay and bring him back in time for the wedding.

videos.title: Where Is Akshay?
videos.overview: Everyone at Ram's home finds out that Akshay is missing. Meera loses all hope of finding him and comes to the Malhotra house to apologize for Akshay's actions.

videos.title: Priya Ka Grah Pravesh
videos.overview: Shivina postpones the wedding so that Akshay can go for the film shoot. Meanwhile, Priya and Ram decide to start their marriage with a gesture of trust.

videos.title: Ice Breaker
videos.overview: Ram burns the prenup contract in front of Priya as a gesture of trust. Meanwhile, Nandini plans her next move to separate Ram and Priya for good.

videos.title: Ram's Surprise
videos.overview: Ram surprises Priya with her favourite dish for breakfast. Vedika is determined to prove Sid's innocence and find out who poisoned Ram's food at the wedding.

videos.title: Gharelu Nuskhe
videos.overview: Priya brings a special home remedy for Ram at his office. Meanwhile, Meera approaches the street vendor to question him about the person who poisoned Ram's food.

videos.overview: Priya's father sees Ram partying with other girls in a drunken state at his office. What will Priya's father do now?

videos.title: Shaadi Ki Kamiyaabi
videos.overview: Priya's father wants to break off the wedding when he sees Ram getting drunk at the party. Meanwhile, Ram's friend Shardul decides to keep Kriti away from Ram so that the wedding can be successful.

videos.title: Ram's Apology
videos.overview: Ram arrives at Priya's house to apologize for his behaviour and save the wedding. Will Priya's father be able to forgive him?

videos.title: Ram Aur Priya Ki Haldi
videos.overview: Ram and Priya's families celebrate their Haldi ceremony before the wedding. Meanwhile, Kriti plans to tell Ram that she is willing to get married to him. Will the wedding be ruined now?

videos.title: Ram Ki Khushi
videos.overview: Kriti asks Ram to tell his mother the truth and marry her instead of Priya. Will Ram be able to do it?

videos.title: The Perfect Wedding Gift
videos.overview: Ram says that he can't hurt his mother by calling off the wedding. Meanwhile, Shreya and Kriti decide to exploit Priya and Yuvraj's past to get the wedding cancelled.

videos.title: Duty Over Shaadi
videos.overview: Priya's family is worried as the wedding venue is not free, and Ram's family in on their way. Meanwhile, Priya gets an emergency call from one of her patients. What will Priya do now?

videos.title: Late For The Wedding
videos.overview: Ram accompanies Priya to her emergency appointment while everyone waits for them at the wedding venue. Shreya gets her hands on Priya and Yuvraj's pictures, and she plans to present them during the wedding.

videos.title: Ram Ka Vaada
videos.overview: Priya feels betrayed when Yuvraj arrives at the wedding function. Meanwhile, Ram makes a promise to Priya's mother before the wedding.

videos.title: Priya Ki Vidai
videos.overview: Ram and Priya get married despite all the efforts by Shreya and Kriti to ruin the wedding. Will this three-month contract marriage change Ram and Priya's lives forever?

videos.title: Shaadi Ki Special Rasam
videos.overview: Priya takes her first steps into the Kapoor mansion, along with Ram. Later, Ram and Priya perform a special wedding ritual together.

videos.title: Post Marriage Interview
videos.overview: Ram and Priya play the ring game together after their wedding. Meanwhile, Priya's college friend, Aradhna, comes to the Kapoor mansion to take her interview.

videos.title: Priya's Protector
videos.overview: Ram and Priya try to figure out their sleeping arrangements on the first day of the marriage. Meanwhile, Kriti feels jealous and video calls Ram.

videos.title: Priya Ki Peheli Rasoi
videos.overview: Ram loses sleep in the night because of Priya's snores. Priya wants to leave for work the next day after marriage, but Ram's family members ask her to stay at home. What will Priya do now?

videos.title: Kapoor Mansion Ki Chaabi
videos.overview: Ram gets late for his date with Kriti because he had to drop Priya off for work. Later, Ram's mother gives Priya the keys to the Kapoor mansion.

videos.title: Priya Ka Jaadu
videos.overview: Priya returns the keys of the house to Ram. Meanwhile, Priya's parents get suspicious about her marriage and they think that Priya is hiding something from them.

videos.title: Priya's Clinic
videos.overview: Priya is angry when she finds out that Ram was the one who shut her clinic down without her permission. Later, Ram's mother goes out of the house without telling anyone.

videos.title: Ram Ki Jaan
videos.overview: Shalini calls Priya and informs her that she has taken a short vacation. Ram is worried that her mother is not taking her surgery seriously. What will happen now?

videos.title: Surprise Honeymoon
videos.overview: Ram's mother pretends to be sick and calls Ram and Priya to Goa. When both of them arrive at the hotel they realize that Ram's mother planned a surprise honeymoon for them. What will they do now?

videos.title: Ram Aur Priya Ki Perfect Jodi
videos.overview: Shalini decides to check on Ram and Priya, as she thinks that one of them is sick. Meanwhile, Kriti uses this opportunity to reveal the truth about her and Ram's relationship. How will Ram and Priya stop this truth from coming out?

videos.title: Memorial Anniversary Ki Planning
videos.overview: Priya helps Shalini prepare for the memorial anniversary of Ram's father. Meanwhile, Kriti comes up with a plan to kick Priya out of Ram's life. Will her plan succeed?

videos.title: Emergency Appointment
videos.overview: Priya gets called for an emergency appointment at the clinic. Meanwhile, Kriti uses this opportunity to impress Shalini and take Priya's place.

videos.title: Priya Ka Intezaar
videos.overview: Priya gets late for the 'Barsi', and everyone waits for her. Shreya and Kriti use this opportunity to discredit Priya in front of Shalini. Will Priya be able to make it in time?

videos.title: Mission Heartbreak
videos.overview: Shalini praises Priya for her thoughtful nature. Ritika gets a modelling contract for an ad shoot in Ram's company. Later, Ram asks Priya to not get too friendly with his mother. What will happen now?

videos.title: Priya's Well Kept Secret
videos.overview: Ram comes up with a plan to distance Shalini from Priya. Meanwhile, Shreya thinks that Priya is keeping something hidden from everyone. What could be Priya's secret?

videos.title: Ideal Bahu Ki Qualities
videos.overview: Ram asks Priya to behave rudely with Shalini and her friends. Later, Priya discovers that someone from the Kapoor family poses a threat to Shalini's life.

videos.title: Rishton Ki Importance
videos.overview: Shreya and Kriti plan to leak Priya and Yuvraj's photos in the media. Later, Ram and Alekha get into an argument about their deteriorating friendship.

videos.title: Priya Ke Life Ka Mystery Man
videos.overview: Priya asks Ram out for coffee and wants to discuss something important with him. Meanwhile, Shreya leaks Yuvraj and Priya's photos in the media.

videos.title: Priya Ke Affair Ki News
videos.overview: Ram finds troubling news about Priya after the media leak. Meanwhile, Priya learns that someone has an agenda against Shalini and is trying to poison her food. Will Ram believe Priya?

videos.title: Ram Ki Business Deal
videos.overview: Ram loses an important business deal because of the scandalous news about Priya. Meanwhile, Kriti tries to take advantage of Ram's sensitive situation.

videos.title: Breaking The Marriage Contract
videos.overview: Ram and Priya express their newly developed feelings for each other. Meanwhile, Kriti panics as she thinks that Ram will dump her if he develops feelings for Priya. What will happen now?

videos.title: The Truth Behind The Silence
videos.overview: Priya's family members are worried that Priya is hiding a big secret from everyone. Meanwhile, the security guard discovers blood in Ram's office. Ram and Priya also seem to be missing. Where have they gone?

videos.title: Ram Aur Priya Ki Kidnapping
videos.overview: Shalini finds out that Priya is innocent and was only helping Ram's cousin Sona with her relationship issues. Meanwhile, Ram and Priya get kidnapped and are stranded in a warehouse somewhere. How will Ram and Priya escape this situation?

videos.title: Mastermind Behind The Kidnapping
videos.overview: Ram and Priya attempt to make an escape from their kidnapper's grasp. Meanwhile, Yuvraj thinks that Shreya might be the one behind the kidnapping. What will happen now?

videos.title: Conspiracy Against Ram
videos.overview: Shreya pays the kidnappers and asks them not to ask for ransom. Alekha feels overwhelmed after taking over Ram's responsibilities in his absence. Meanwhile, Ram's cousins try to take advantage of this situation and take over all of Ram's property.

videos.title: Kapoor Family Ke Dushman
videos.overview: The police and Shardul get a clue to find out where Ram and Priya are being held. Meanwhile, Ritika learns that Shreya was the one behind the kidnapping. What will happen now?

videos.title: Contract Marriage Ka The End
videos.overview: Shreya confesses to all the attempts she and her family members made against Ram and his mother. Meanwhile, Ram and Priya return home safely and turn their contract marriage into a real one.

videos.title: Bhagyashree Ka Akelapan
videos.overview: When Bhagyashree's strict father mistakenly believes she's already married, he invites her and her husband to a family wedding. Sensing a rare chance to mend broken ties, Bhagyashree scrambles to turn the lie into a lifeline.

videos.title: A Potential Match
videos.overview: Rishabh opens up to Sunny, while Bhagyashree meets a potential match. Will he be the one she introduces to her parents?

videos.title: Bhagyashree's Past
videos.overview: Bhagyashree is stunned to learn that the man she went on a date with is actually her boss. Meanwhile, Rishabh discovers the truth about her past. How will she react knowing Rishabh has heard it all?

videos.title: Bhagyashree Gets A Ride Home
videos.overview: Rishabh has seven days to vacate his house. Later, Bhagyashree shares a ride home with Vikram. With her parents soon arriving in Mumbai, will she find the right match in time?

videos.title: Bhagyashree's Mangetar
videos.overview: Rishabh is torn after discovering Vikram is engaged to both Bhagyashree and Shaina. How will he confront Bhagyashree with the truth?

videos.title: Vikram Ka Plan
videos.overview: Vikram frames Rishabh as a thief, ruining his reputation at work. How will Bhagyashree respond when the truth comes to light?

videos.title: Vikram And Bhagyashree's Wedding
videos.overview: On the wedding day, Vikram is exposed as a fraud, leading Bhagyashree to call off the marriage. But how will she face her parents now?

videos.title: Bhagyashree Meets Her Family
videos.overview: After five long years, Bhagyashree reunites with her family and learns about her father's declining health. Who will step up to pose as her husband in front of her parents?

videos.title: Shaadi Ka Natak
videos.overview: Bhagyashree's relatives bombard Rishabh with questions. Amidst growing tension and tangled lies, will the truth catch up with them both?

videos.title: Bhagyashree's Parents Come Home
videos.overview: Bhagyashree's parents arrive unannounced, putting pressure on her and Rishabh. With tension rising, can they keep their lie hidden?

videos.title: Bhagyashree Gets Accused
videos.overview: Mukul Chaddha storms into Bhagyashree's house, accusing her of lying about her marriage and claiming Rishabh isn't her husband. How will Rishabh tackle the confrontation and prove their relationship?

videos.title: Society Meeting For Rishabh And Bhagyashree
videos.overview: Rishabh and Bhagyashree prepare themselves for the society meeting, knowing Mukul Chaddha is planning to expose them. Will they be able to outsmart him this time?

videos.title: Lakho Mein Ek Damaad
videos.overview: Rishabh outwits Chaddha, confirming Bhagyashree's marital status. But just as things settle, Somi presents a document that could put Bhagyashree in trouble. How will she handle this twist?

videos.title: Nav Vivahit Jode Ke Liye Rasam
videos.overview: Bhagyashree and Rishabh perform a post-marriage ritual at their mother's request. With her father finally convinced of their relationship, is a new challenge on the horizon?

videos.title: Rishabh Gets Followed
videos.overview: Bhagyashree's father secretly follows Rishabh to uncover his truth, while her brother Shreyas confronts her for lying about their marriage. Will Rishabh's secret come to light?

videos.title: Bhagyashree's Father In Jail
videos.overview: Bhagyashree's father lands in jail as the family tries to secure his release. Will he reveal Rishabh's truth to all, or will Rishabh manage to stay a step ahead?

videos.title: Rishabh Is Exposed
videos.overview: Vinayak follows Rishabh and catches him at a hotel with a girl, determined to expose him. How will Rishabh explain himself now?

videos.title: Mangal Snanam
videos.overview: As Bhagyashree begins to feel uneasy seeing Rishabh interact with his girlfriend, the two attend the Mangal Snanam together. But when Rishabh arrives drunk for the ceremony, how will Bhagyashree deal with the situation?

videos.title: Bhagyashree's Insecurity
videos.overview: Bhagyashree grows uneasy with Rishabh's changing behaviour. As her parents prepare to gift them a property, Mukul Chaddha stirs up fresh trouble. How will Bhagyashree and Rishabh handle the mounting pressure?

videos.title: Dance Competition In Happy Home Towers
videos.overview: Rishabh confronts Bhagyashree about the growing distance between them. After an argument with Mukul Chaddha, Bhagyashree challenges him to a dance competition between the boys and the society girls. Who will win?

videos.title: Bhagyashree Confronts Rishabh
videos.overview: Bhagyashree learns that Mia is pregnant and decides to confront Rishabh. With Mia's pregnancy and the dance competition both coming up, how will Rishabh and Bhagyashree handle everything?

videos.title: Revathi And Rishabh's Connection
videos.overview: Bhagyashree is shocked to discover the connection between Revathi and Rishabh and questions Mia about it. As Rishabh comes forward to support Revathi, how will Bhagyashree react when she uncovers the truth?

videos.title: Revathi's Truth
videos.overview: Vinayak is stunned to see his wife performing at the dance competition. Later, Bhagyashree uncovers the truth about the connection between Mia, Rishabh, and Revathi. How will she react after learning everything?

videos.title: Mia's Evil Ploy
videos.overview: Holding Rishabh at gunpoint, Mia paralyses him and takes him away, while Bhagyashree follows closely behind. Will Bhagyashree be able to save him in time?

videos.title: Mini Honeymoon For Rishabh And Bhagyashree
videos.overview: Bhagyashree's parents surprise her and Rishabh with a trip to Mumbai. While in the city, she receives an invite to her friend's birthday party. Will this trip bring her and Rishabh closer, or will it force her to face her past once again?

videos.title: Pyaar Ki Innocent Nishani
videos.overview: Rishabh stands up to Bhagyashree's ex and firmly puts him in his place. As Rishabh and Bhagyashree spend time together in Mumbai, she finally expresses her love for him. How will Rishabh respond?

videos.title: Rishabh Ki Sachhai
videos.overview: As Bhagyashree begins to fall in love with Rishabh, he hides his true intentions. Who is Rishabh really, and what is it that he wants from Bhagyashree?

videos.title: Bhagyashree's Growing Closeness
videos.overview: Rishabh is troubled by his father's illness, while Bhagyashree senses something is bothering him and tries to understand what it is. As she finds herself falling deeper for him, will Rishabh reveal his true self to her?

videos.title: Karthik Is Tortured
videos.overview: Purab tortures Karthik to get his hands on his money. Meanwhile, Rishabh and Bhagyashree return from their trip, and Rishabh subtly begins convincing Karthik to get Vinayak to sign the property papers.

videos.title: Karthik And Soumya's Disagreement
videos.overview: Karthik and Soumya have a disagreement when she suggests he start a business. Later, Shekhar runs away from his own wedding with Rishabh. What are they planning?

videos.title: Purab Gets The Papers
videos.overview: Meenakshi locks herself in her room. Meanwhile, Karthik hands over the property papers to Purab. Will Rishabh manage to bring Shekhar back to the wedding?

videos.title: Shekhar Aur Meenakshi Ki Shaadi
videos.overview: Dr. Ramya attends Shekhar and Meenakshi's wedding as Soumya attempts to expose Rishabh's truth. Later, Purab questions Rishabh about his intentions toward Bhagyashree's family.

videos.title: Rishabh Finds Proof
videos.overview: The society ladies set up a date for Bhagyashree and Rishabh as he tries to get her fingerprints. Meanwhile, as Vinayak and his family return to Chennai, they are asked to vacate their home. How will the family react to this sudden shock?

videos.title: Bhagyashree Is Blamed
videos.overview: While Vinayak and the family are made to leave the house, Bhagyashree models for a brand to help out. Later, things take a turn when she is accused of selling important documents and taken to the police. How will Bhagyashree face this sudden crisis?

videos.title: Padma And Vinayak's Suffering
videos.overview: Rishabh questions Bhagyashree about the large transaction, while Padma and Vinayak discover that Karthik was behind it as he secretly sold the house. Later, Rishabh rushes his father to the hospital. Will Bhagyashree uncover the truth about him?

videos.title: Bhagyashree Donates Blood
videos.overview: As Bhagyashree follows Rishabh to the hospital, he opens up to her about his father. Later, without knowing his identity, Bhagyashree ends up donating blood to Rishabh's father. How will Rishabh respond when he finds out?

videos.title: Naysa's Arrival
videos.overview: Bhagyashree confronts Purab for taking over her parents' house, while Purab begins to suspect that Rishabh has feelings for her. Meanwhile, Naysa arrives in Delhi after learning that some important documents have been stolen.

videos.title: Rishabh And Bhagyashree's Feelings
videos.overview: Naysa asks Bhagyashree if she has feelings for Rishabh, while Rishabh prepares for his father's upcoming court hearing. Later, he opens up to his father about how he feels for Bhagyashree.

videos.title: Ek Dusre Ke Humsafar
videos.overview: Naysa and Bhagyashree meet with an accident and are rushed to City Hospital. When Rishabh arrives to check on Bhagyashree, he finally confesses his feelings for her. But what will happen when Bhagyashree finds out about Rishabh and Naysa's past?

videos.title: Rishabh Tries To Meet The Witnesses
videos.overview: Rishabh talks to his lawyer about his father's case and asks to meet the witnesses. Meanwhile, Soumya goes back to Karthik. Will Rishabh get to meet the eyewitnesses and uncover the truth about Bhagyashree?

videos.title: Teej Ka Vrat
videos.overview: Bhagyashree and the society ladies decide to observe a fast for Teej, while Rishabh tries to uncover her reasons for the court statement. Will he learn the truth?

videos.title: Rishabh Finds The Truth
videos.overview: Bhagyashree and the other women keep a fast. Later, Rishabh learns the truth about her court statement from the victim. Will this change his perception of Bhagyashree?

videos.title: Rishabh Ka Sach
videos.overview: Rishabh is about to express his feelings to Bhagyashree when Naysa walks in and reveals his truth. How will Bhagyashree respond?

videos.title: Bhagyashree Is Broken
videos.overview: Bhagyashree feels shattered after learning the truth about Rishabh. Six months later, she begins rebuilding her life with the support of her friends and family. Will love find her this time?

videos.title: Bhagyashree Ki Life Ka Dusra Adhyay
videos.overview: As Bhagyashree steps into the new year, Rishabh takes charge of Kalos and returns to her life as her boss. Will he manage to win back her trust?

videos.title: Bhagyashree's New Neighbour
videos.overview: Rishabh becomes Bhagyashree's new neighbour to get closer to her, but Bhagyashree plans to move out. Will his efforts truly bring them together?

videos.title: Nikhil's Proposal For Bhagyashree
videos.overview: Nikhil proposes to Bhagyashree in the office, while Revathi introduces her fiance to the family. How will Rishabh handle this situation?

videos.title: Rishabh Ki Koshish
videos.overview: After learning that Purab is Revathi's fiance, Vinayak refuses the alliance. Later, Rishabh opens up to Padma about his love for Bhagyashree. Will Padma support him?

videos.title: Rishabh And Bhagyashree Get Stuck
videos.overview: Sunny announces to everyone that Bhagyashree has agreed to marry Nikhil, while Bhagyashree finds herself stuck in the meter room with Rishabh, where they confront each other. Will this moment bring them closer and help reconcile their issues?

videos.title: Bhagyashree's Engagement
videos.overview: Bhagyashree asks Vinayak to wait before the engagement, but he refuses. Meanwhile, the preparations are in full swing. Will she go ahead and get engaged to Nikhil?

videos.title: Revathi Is Pregnant
videos.overview: During the engagement, Revathi suddenly faints and the truth comes out that she is pregnant with Purab's child. How will the family handle this shocking revelation?

videos.title: Rishabh's Pain
videos.overview: Bhagyashree openly declares in front of Rishabh and her colleagues that she is engaged. Later, circumstances force Rishabh and Bhagyashree to share the same cabin. Will this situation bring them closer?

videos.title: Bhagyashree's Care For Rishabh
videos.overview: Rishabh and Bhagyashree head out for a client meeting but their car suddenly breaks down. Soon, a group of goons surrounds them. How will they deal with this dangerous situation?

videos.title: Nikhil's Plan
videos.overview: Nikhil plots to take Bhagyashree away from the hotel. Later, her peanut allergy gets triggered while eating. Will Rishabh step in to save her?

videos.title: Complaint Against Rishabh
videos.overview: Rishabh shows his care for Bhagyashree while Naysa confronts Purab and the Iyer family. Later, Rishabh faces a shocking accusation of harassing a female employee. How will he prove his innocence?

videos.title: Rishabh's Confession
videos.overview: The allegation against Rishabh spreads in the media, putting their business deals at risk. Meanwhile, Karthik receives recognition for his efforts. Just as Bhagyashree sets out to prove Rishabh's innocence, Rishabh makes a shocking confession.

videos.title: Naysa's Statement
videos.overview: Bhagyashree questions Nikhil for deliberately putting peanuts in her food. Meanwhile, Naysa holds a press conference to address the allegations against Rishabh. What turn will Rishabh's fate take?

videos.title: Bhagyashree Cares For Rishabh
videos.overview: Rishabh gives Naysa the divorce papers, but she refuses to sign. Meanwhile, Karthik tries to uncover the identity of the person sending him money every month. Later, Bhagyashree looks after a sick Rishabh.

videos.title: Nikhil Puts Bhagyashree In The Spot
videos.overview: Bhagyashree slaps Nikhil for his inappropriate remarks. Meanwhile, Karthik questions Purab about Rishabh's investment in his startup. Later, Nikhil stuns Vinayak and the family by claiming that Bhagyashree still loves Rishabh.

videos.title: Vinayak's Health
videos.overview: Vinayak's health worsens and the doctor is urgently called. Later, Bhagyashree reveals the truth about Nikhil to the family. How will everyone react to her revelation?

videos.title: Purab Calls Off The Wedding
videos.overview: Purab breaks off his wedding with Revathi after discovering she has been secretly watching him. Soon after, Tanya uploads a video publicly accusing Revathi. How will Revathi handle this blow?

videos.title: Karthik Confronts His Family
videos.overview: Purab confronts Tanya about the video, only to discover that Naysa was behind it. Meanwhile, Karthik speaks to his family, reminding them of Rishabh's good qualities. Will Revathi and Purab find their way back to each other?

videos.title: Purab Ki Condition
videos.overview: Bhagyashree reaches out to console Revathi, while Rishabh tries to comfort Purab. Later, Purab puts forward a condition that he will only marry Revathi if Bhagyashree and Rishabh tie the knot first. How will the family respond to this?

videos.title: Bhagyashree Confronts Naysa
videos.overview: While Bhagyashree finally accepts her love for Rishabh, Naysa refuses to sign the divorce papers. Later, Bhagyashree confronts her to get the papers signed. Will Naysa agree, or will she find another way to create trouble?

videos.title: Naysa's Betrayal
videos.overview: Rishabh meets Naysa to get the divorce papers signed, but she spikes his drink. Later, he discovers that the papers were fake. How will Rishabh deal with this betrayal?

videos.title: Naysa's Marriage Proposal
videos.overview: Shreyas receives the good news of a job opportunity in London. Meanwhile, Rishabh goes to confront Naysa, where Gautam pressures him to marry her. How will Rishabh respond?

videos.title: Rishabh's Forceful Marriage
videos.overview: Vinayak gets hold of Rishabh and Naysa's pictures just as Bhagyashree tries to confront him. Meanwhile, Rishabh is forced into marrying Naysa while in an unconscious state. Will Bhagyashree reach in time to save him?

videos.title: Mr And Mrs Kapoor
videos.overview: In a surprising turn of events, Bhagyashree and Rishabh tie the knot. Meanwhile, Karthik waits at the hospital for the good news of his baby's arrival.

videos.title: Happy Ending For The Kapoors
videos.overview: Bhagyashree performs her first Rasoi ritual while Gautam surprises Bhagyashree and Rishabh with tickets to Paris. Meanwhile, Revathi and Purab joyfully decide on the name of their soon-to-be-born child.
